referenceSources.description:
This race‑prepared Maserati Biturbo Si was campaigned in the 1988 Group A touring car championship by the Marlboro Conquista team and driven by Thomas Lindström. Finished in white and red Marlboro livery with the number 12 on its hood and doors, it carries Bilstein and BBS decals and rides on 16‑inch gold BBS wheels with Dunlop tires. Under the hood sits a 2.5‑litre V6 engine driving the rear wheels through a five‑speed dogleg manual gearbox.

Inside, the car is equipped with FIA‑approved safety gear including a white roll cage, Mirco RS2 bucket seat, Apex harness, two‑spoke Momo steering wheel, battery cut‑offs, and a Premier Fuel Systems safety fuel cell. The sale includes its FIA Historic Technical Passport valid until December 2032, Automobile Club d’Italia documents, a detailed competition history, a collection of spare parts, and original correspondence between Maserati and Marlboro Conquista. Recently serviced by Euro Racing in 2023, this Biturbo Si remains a turnkey example of late‑1980s touring car competition machinery.
